preview.what: Designing tables so data is stored once and stays consistent.
preview.picture: One address book, not five: if a customer's phone lives in one place, changing it changes it everywhere. Normalisation is deciding what goes in which table and how they link.
preview.why: Interviewers give you a messy spreadsheet and ask you to design the tables.
preview.bn: Data একবার রাখো, table-এ ভাগ করো, key দিয়ে জোড়ো — বদলালে এক জায়গায়ই বদলাবে।
